categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Qingyi Photomask Limited primarily engages in the research, design, production, and sales of photomasks used in flat panel displays and semiconductor chips. Its product portfolio includes quartz and soda-lime photomasks applied in industries such as flat panel displays, semiconductors, touchscreens, and circuit boards. The company operates through subsidiaries focusing on photomask manufacturing and technology development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company relies on advanced photolithography technologies including laser direct writing and electron beam writing for photomask production. It has developed proprietary core process technologies such as HTM (Half Tone Mask), PSM (Phase Shift Mask), and OPC (Optical Proximity Correction) to enhance precision. The manufacturing process is highly automated and conducted in cleanroom environments with in-house developed equipment for measurement, cleaning, and defect detection.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading flat panel display manufacturers like BOE, Visionox, HKC, Tianma, CSOT, and semiconductor companies including Chiplink Integrated, Sanan Optoelectronics, Aiker, Silan Microelectronics, and others. The end markets served include consumer electronics (smartphones, tablets, laptops, smartwatches), automotive displays, AI chips, IoT devices, and advanced semiconductor packaging.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Shenzhen, Hefei, Foshan, and subsidiaries in Hong Kong. Its sales cover domestic Chinese markets extensively and also include exports to regions such as Taiwan and Singapore. The company aims to expand its global footprint while leveraging China's growing share in flat panel display and semiconductor manufacturing.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qingyi Photomask operates upstream in the electronic manufacturing supply chain, producing critical photomasks that serve as lithographic templates for downstream flat panel display and semiconductor chip fabrication. It is positioned as a key supplier of high-precision photomasks essential for manufacturing processes in the electronics industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes independent innovation and continuous R&D investment focused on enhancing photomask precision and expanding product types, including high-end HTM and PSM masks. It is advancing technology for 8.6 generation TFT, 6 generation AMOLED/LTPS, and semiconductor nodes down to 28nm. Strategic priorities include capacity expansion, technology breakthroughs in high-precision masks, and supporting domestic substitution to reduce reliance on imports.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized photomask products to flat panel display and semiconductor manufacturers. The company operates on a make-to-order basis, with sales contracts directly signed with customers. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and acceptance of products, with payments collected accordingly.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company ranks as one of the largest and leading photomask manufacturers in China and is globally ranked fifth in flat panel display photomask sales. Major international competitors include companies from the US, Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan such as Photronics, Toppan, HOYA, DNP, and LG-IT. Qingyi Photomask is recognized for its growing technological capabilities and expanding market share, especially in the domestic Chinese market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 924 million, a 21.26% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 134 million, up 35.18%. Total assets reached RMB 2.08 billion, growing 19.14% from the previous year. The company maintains a healthy cash flow with operating cash inflows increasing by 44.19%. R&D investment accounted for 5.3% of revenue, supporting sustained growth and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qingyi Photomask offers high-precision, technologically advanced photomask products with strong in-house R&D capabilities, enabling it to meet the stringent requirements of high-end flat panel display and semiconductor manufacturing. Its dual production bases in Shenzhen and Hefei provide proximity advantages for domestic customers, ensuring timely delivery and responsive service. The company’s focus on breaking foreign monopolies and promoting domestic substitution enhances its competitive edge and value to customers.
